page.overview:
Who is Silviana Brehon?

She is stocky with a square face and speaks with a gruff voice. She has her dark hair in a bun and has large eyes.

She is physically very strong; she reminds people of a strict aunt, the one who would not stand for any nonsense, but who views her nieces and nephews as a raw material to be whipped into shape as human beings. This may have been a factor in her being chosen as Mistress of Novices.

Silviana is strong in the One Power, with a strength level of . After the events of The Path of Daggers, there are only four women stronger than her in the White Tower that we have details on, three of whom are also Sitters. The other is, of course, the Amyrlin Seat herself.

Silviana is 151 years old. She was born in the year 849 NE in Amadicia and went to the Tower in . After spending twelve years as novice and eleven as Accepted, she was raised to the shawl in the year 890 NE.
